evidence: Homepage lists 8 heritage items (春节, 端午龙舟, 剪纸, 京剧, 昆曲, 书法, 苏绣, 宜兴紫砂) each with image, category, title, and description shown in a grid.
Clicking "了解详情" link on 春节 card navigated to /heritage/spring-festival dedicated detail page; same pattern verified for 苏绣 (/heritage/suzhou-embroidery).

Detail page for 春节 shows title (春节/Spring Festival), category badge, full description paragraph (4000+ years history detail), region (北京 · 华夏大地), inscription year (2006年入选), and an image gallery with 3 thumbnails that can be browsed.
Category combobox lists 传统工艺/传统表演/民俗活动/传统美术; selecting 传统工艺 filtered list from 8 to 2 items (苏绣, 宜兴紫砂), confirming category-based browsing works.

After opening 苏绣 hotspot overlay in panorama view, navigating to its detail page, then clicking "返回全景探索", the panorama view returned with the same hotspot overlay for 苏绣 still open showing identical content. Filter/search state and image gallery selection also persisted correctly during interaction.

Panorama view showed "正在加载热点... (4/8)" loading progress prompt while hotspots loaded. Detail page for 春节 showed "图片加载失败" (image failed to load) prompt for a broken image thumbnail, with other thumbnails loading correctly.
Each of the 8 items displays exactly one category badge; all 4 required categories (传统工艺, 传统表演, 民俗活动, 传统美术) are represented across the item set (e.g. 春节=民俗活动, 京剧=传统表演, 苏绣=传统工艺, 剪纸=传统美术).

Clicking non-interactive homepage content (e.g. the "43" stat number) did not navigate away from "/". Only the "了解详情" links and panorama hotspot "查看详情" links (which point to valid /heritage/* routes) triggered navigation to a detail page.
Every list card and detail page inspected (春节, 苏绣) included title (heading + English subtitle), description paragraph, and region info (e.g. 北京 · 华夏大地, 江苏 · 江南水乡).

List view shows a grid of cards with breadcrumbs absent; detail view shows a breadcrumb trail (首页/非遗项目/苏绣), large image gallery, single-item layout with "返回全景探索" and "浏览更多项目" actions — visually and structurally distinct from the list/grid view.

All 8 exhibited items (春节 Spring Festival, 端午龙舟 Dragon Boat Racing, 剪纸 Paper Cutting, 京剧 Peking Opera, 昆曲 Kunqu Opera, 书法 Chinese Calligraphy, 苏绣 Suzhou Embroidery, 宜兴紫砂 Yixing Purple Clay) are genuine, well-known Chinese ICH items with accurate regional attributions (Beijing, Guangdong, Shaanxi, Jiangsu, Anhui) and plausible historical details (e.g. 苏绣 correctly noted as one of China's Four Famous Embroideries, inscribed on the national ICH list in 2006).
